title: FastAPI Inventory
description: Inventory manager with product CRUD and stock restocking.

techDetails.scope: Built to learn Python backend architecture from scratch, focusing on FastAPI validation, PostgreSQL modeling, and clean REST patterns.
highlights: FastAPI REST API with Pydantic v2 validation and Swagger UI docs
PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy ORM for data modeling, sessions, and startup database seeding
React dashboard for inventory and stock management

title: SpringMart
description: Product catalog with multi-field search, pagination, and direct image streaming.

techDetails.scope: Built to construct and containerize a full-stack product catalog with Spring Boot, implementing layered architecture, JPQL multi-field search, direct image byte streaming, and Docker deployment.
techDetails.architecture: Java • Spring Boot • Spring Data JPA • H2 • Docker • React
highlights: Spring Boot REST API with custom JPQL multi-field search, pagination, and startup auto-seeding in H2
Multipart product CRUD endpoints with validation and direct raw-byte image streaming
Containerized backend with Docker deployed on Render connected to a React client on Netlify

title: Student Management System
description: Console Java app for student records and performance reports.

techDetails.scope: My first coding project—built to learn core Java and relational databases, architecting a layered backend application from scratch.
highlights: Layered console architecture separating business logic from database operations
MySQL queries via JDBC using parameterized PreparedStatements against SQL injection
SQL queries for student performance and grade distribution reports

title: wrkout
description: Minimal workout tracker for PPL splits and progressive overload.

techDetails.scope: Built at 94 kg (Class 1 obesity) when I first joined the gym. I tailored it around a Push-Pull-Legs split to track overload and stay consistent without friction. Used it to lose 30 kg (66 lbs) in 1 year.
highlights: Fast set logging with inline steppers and tactile feedback
Progressive overload and volume tracking for PPL splits
Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS)

title: Shreyan's Arc
description: Interactive DSA roadmap curating 58 problems across 17 patterns.

techDetails.scope: DSA prep felt overwhelming with endless unfocused question lists. After analyzing Blind 75 and Sean Prashad’s list, I curated 58 high-yield problems across 17 patterns into an interactive canvas to practice without friction.
highlights: Interactive pan-and-zoom canvas to customize roadmap layout
Firebase Auth and Cloud Firestore to sync progress across devices
58 handpicked interview problems across 17 core DSA patterns
Direct LeetCode problem links for every question on the roadmap

title: J-Void
description: Distraction-free Java practice editor with no compiler.

techDetails.scope: Built as a distraction-free in-browser editor stripped of LeetCode's UI clutter, tailored solely for writing and reviewing clean Java solutions.
highlights: Monaco code editor with automatic Allman brace formatting
Custom line bookmarking in the editor gutter for quick review
Direct LeetCode links aligned with Shreyan's Arc roadmap

title: WealthWise
description: Financial advisory platform with interactive calculators.

techDetails.scope: Built for my father to streamline client onboarding. Prospective clients can explore advisory services and run financial calculators before meeting him, turning cold inquiries into prepared consultations.
highlights: Interactive calculators for Investment, Retirement, Education, and Marriage planning
Direct WhatsApp lead routing and customizable advisor branding
